title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Sixth edition, Volume 20, SUI-ZYM - EB.11
text:
VITAL, in Physiology, an appellation given to what-
ever missive principally to the constitutip or main-
taining life in the bodies of trust, then the heart,
huges, and brain, are called vital part; and the opra-
tions of these parts by which the life of animals is main-
tained are called _vital functions._
